source_semantics: RefreshPreviewAsync delegates to ReloadAsync using the currently selected older-than-days and keep-latest policy values.
Laravel exposes the same source policy choices: older than 30, 60, 90, 180, or 365 days and keep latest 50, 100, 250, or 500 records.
Changing either policy selector or pressing Refresh preview re-reads tenant-scoped storage and preview data without executing cleanup or another mutation.
The refresh control has deterministic loading, refreshed, and fail-closed error feedback.
The existing tenant-scoped SiteOperationHistoryService read runtime is reused rather than introducing a second maintenance architecture.
The response is bound to the exact selected operation and accepted policy and does not terminalize the separate ReloadAsync operation.
security: caller cannot supply site, history, cleanup, or retention mutation identifiers
older_than_days and keep_latest are allowlisted to the authoritative source choices and invalid values fail with validation errors
refresh transport is GET-only and does not call cleanup or clear operations
frontend rejects cross-origin refresh destinations and mismatched operation or policy responses
